query: Build a weekly newsletter to grow our audience on LinkedIn and X. It is not tied to onboarding, retention, product education, or win-back.
expected_behavior: Refuses to treat an audience-growth newsletter as lifecycle by default.
Explains that lifecycle owns newsletters tied to activation, retention, win-back, or product education.
Routes editorial audience-growth distribution to content distribution.
Does not design a triggered lifecycle program when no lifecycle state exists.
